high.title: Mining RKAB Discussions Tomorrow: Government and Parliament to Address Issue Threatening Hundreds of Thousands of Layoffs
high.summary: The Indonesian Confederation of Trade Unions (KSPSI) revealed that 90% of mining operations have halted due to unresolved Work Plan and Budget (RKAB) approvals, threatening hundreds of thousands of jobs. A coordination meeting between the government and parliament is scheduled for June 30 to address the issue. This is a critical sector-wide disruption affecting mining companies, heavy equipment operators, and supporting industries listed on the Indonesian stock exchange.

high.title: IHSG Closes Down 1.28%, Remains Below 6,000
high.summary: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 5,820, falling 75 points (1.28%) on Monday, June 29, 2026, after opening in the green at 5,932. The index remains stubbornly below the 6,000 level, with an intraday low of 5,800, signaling continued bearish sentiment. This persistent weakness is a concern for investors as the market struggles to regain momentum.

high.title: Indonesian Capital Market Threatened with Demotion from Emerging to Frontier Market Status by MSCI
high.summary: Indonesia's capital market faces a potential downgrade from Emerging Markets to Frontier Markets in MSCI's November index review, as revealed in the MSCI 2026 Market Classification Review announced on June 24. IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik stated that MSCI is awaiting consistency in capital market reforms being carried out by Self-Regulatory Organizations (SROs). A downgrade would likely trigger significant foreign capital outflows and further pressure on the IHSG and the Rupiah.

high.title: Official: Jeffrey Hendrik Appointed as New CEO of Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX)
high.summary: Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) held its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (RUPST) on June 29, 2026, where Jeffrey Hendrik was officially appointed as President Director for the 2026-2030 period. Previously serving as Acting President Director, Hendrik has set an ambitious target to bring IDX into the top 10 global exchanges by market capitalization and transaction value, up from its current rankings of 19th and 17th respectively. This leadership transition is significant for Indonesian capital market investors as it signals the strategic direction and priorities for the exchange over the next four years.

high.title: BPK Chairman: Rising State Expenditure Amid Increasingly Limited Fiscal Space
high.summary: Indonesia's Supreme Audit Agency (BPK) Chairman Isma Yatun warned that rising state expenditure is occurring against a backdrop of increasingly constrained fiscal space, highlighting significant challenges in managing the state budget. The remarks were made during a plenary session of the House of Representatives (DPR) while presenting the audit results of the 2025 Central Government Financial Report (LKPP). This signals potential fiscal pressures that could impact government spending priorities, bond issuance, and overall macroeconomic stability in Indonesia.

high.title: Three Facts About CNG as a Replacement for 3kg LPG
high.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) is preparing 3kg Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) as an alternative energy source to subsidized 3kg LPG, aiming to reduce import dependency. Indonesia currently consumes 8.5 million tons of LPG per year but only produces 1.8-1.9 million tons domestically, with the remainder imported. The government plans to price CNG at the same level as subsidized LPG to avoid burdening consumers, representing a significant energy policy shift.

high.title: Live Chicken Prices to Be Pushed Up to IDR 19,500/kg Starting July 15
high.summary: The Indonesian Ministry of Agriculture is intervening in the poultry market after live chicken prices at the farm level collapsed below the cost of production, particularly in Java. The government has set a minimum floor price of IDR 19,500/kg for live chickens effective July 15, 2026, with measures including accelerated offtake and increased slaughterhouse capacity. Compliance will be monitored by multiple agencies including the National Food Task Force, the National Police, and the KPPU competition watchdog, signaling a structured government intervention in the agriculture sector.

high.title: BPK Chairman: State Spending Increases Amid Increasingly Limited Fiscal Space
high.summary: The Chairman of Indonesia's Supreme Audit Agency (BPK) highlighted growing pressure on the state budget, warning that rising expenditure needs are colliding with shrinking fiscal room. This came during the presentation of the 2025 Central Government Financial Report (LKPP) at the DPR plenary session, signaling potential fiscal risks for Indonesia's economy. Investors should monitor this as it may impact government borrowing, bond yields, and future spending priorities.

high.title: Pertamina Cuts Prices of Pertamax Turbo, Pertamina Dex, Dexlite, and Avtur Effective July 1
high.summary: Pertamina Patra Niaga has reduced prices for non-subsidized fuels including Pertamax Turbo (RON 98), Pertamina Dex (CN 53), Dexlite (CN 51), and aviation fuel (Avtur), effective July 1, 2026. The adjustment reflects falling global oil prices and was coordinated with the government as part of a regular pricing review mechanism. This price reduction could ease inflation pressures and benefit transportation and logistics sectors in Indonesia.

high.title: IHSG Drop of Nearly 40% from All-Time High is One of the Worst in History, Says DPR Commission XI Chair
high.summary: DPR Commission XI Chairman Misbakhun highlighted that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) has fallen approximately 40% from its all-time high of around 9,000 at the start of 2026, closing at 5,654.19 today. He described this decline as one of the most severe in Indonesia's stock market history. This raises serious concerns for investors about market stability and the overall health of Indonesia's capital markets.

high.title: Jakarta Plans to Issue Rp 3.5 Trillion in Regional Bonds — A First in Indonesia
high.summary: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung announced plans to issue Rp 3.5 trillion in regional bonds, marking the first-ever regional bond issuance by any provincial government in Indonesia. The move is aimed at offsetting fiscal pressure caused by a Rp 15 trillion cut in central government revenue-sharing transfers (DBH/TKD) to Jakarta. This is a landmark development for Indonesia's sub-sovereign debt market and could open the door for other provinces to follow suit.

high.title: OJK Prepares Regulation for IDX Demutualization — Kemenkeu, BI, and Danantara to Become Shareholders
high.summary: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) is drafting a new regulation (POJK) to facilitate the demutualization of the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX/BEI), as mandated by the P2SK Law. The regulation will transform IDX from a mutual to a demutual ownership structure, allowing state institutions such as the Ministry of Finance (Kemenkeu), Bank Indonesia (BI), and sovereign wealth fund Danantara to become shareholders. This structural transformation could significantly change the governance and strategic direction of Indonesia's primary capital market infrastructure.

medium.title: Finance Minister Praises Lippo Group's 30-Hectare Land Donation at Meikarta for Government's 3 Million Homes Program
medium.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa praised PT Lippo Cikarang Tbk's donation of approximately 30 hectares of land in the Meikarta area to support the government's strategic 3 million homes construction program. This move signals a thawing relationship between the Lippo Group and the government, which is relevant for $LPCK and the broader property sector. The program is a key presidential priority under the Asta Cita agenda aimed at expanding affordable housing access.

medium.title: Government to Take Over PT Granito via Danantara or New Investor if Company Refuses to Continue Operations Despite Gas Price Cuts
medium.summary: The government has decided to intervene and take over ceramic tile manufacturer PT Granito if its owners choose not to resume operations, even after industrial gas prices were reduced. Two options are on the table: acquisition through state investment vehicle Danantara, or finding a new investor. This signals an increasing willingness by the government to intervene in struggling industrial companies to prevent layoffs, with 447 workers already dismissed.

medium.title: GoCar Cancellation Fee of Rp 3,000 Now in Effect: Here Are the Terms
medium.summary: GoTo's ride-hailing platform Gojek has begun implementing a Rp 3,000 cancellation fee for GoCar services (excluding GoCar Instant and GoCar Rental), rolled out gradually across major Indonesian cities since February. This policy change is relevant to $GOTO investors as it represents a monetization improvement aimed at reducing revenue losses from order cancellations. The policy will be evaluated periodically before expanding to other cities.

medium.title: IDX Chief Sets Ambitious Target of 1,100 New Listed Companies by 2030
medium.summary: IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik unveiled ambitious targets for 2026–2030, including growing market capitalization to IDR 30,000 trillion and achieving an average daily transaction value of IDR 31 trillion by 2030. The targets also include onboarding 1,100 new listed companies over the period. These goals reflect the exchange's long-term growth strategy but will require significant improvement in market conditions and investor confidence.

medium.title: IDX Chief Responds to Possibility of Ministry of Finance and Danantara Becoming Exchange Shareholders
medium.summary: IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik confirmed the exchange is awaiting implementing regulations under the Financial Sector Development and Strengthening (P2SK) Law, which could allow the Ministry of Finance, Bank Indonesia, and BPI Danantara to become shareholders of the IDX through demutualization. Hendrik expressed full support for the demutualization process and committed to ongoing coordination with all relevant parties. This structural change could significantly alter the governance and strategic direction of Indonesia's stock exchange.

medium.title: Salary Already Taxed, Why Is JHT (Old-Age Security) Taxed Again Upon Withdrawal?
medium.summary: Special Presidential Advisor for Labor Affairs Said Iqbal has proposed eliminating the income tax on BPJS Ketenagakerjaan JHT (old-age security) withdrawals, arguing that workers' wages have already been subject to Article 21 income tax (PPh 21) and taxing JHT payouts constitutes double taxation. He plans to submit a formal letter to the Finance Minister to discuss zeroing out taxes on JHT, severance pay, pension benefits, and holiday allowances (THR). If adopted, this policy change would benefit millions of Indonesian workers and could affect government tax revenue calculations.

medium.title: Pertamax Turbo to Avtur Prices Drop Starting July 1
medium.summary: Pertamina Patra Niaga has adjusted non-subsidized fuel prices downward effective July 1, 2026, covering Pertamax Turbo (RON 98), Pertamina Dex (CN 53), and Dexlite (CN 51). The price revision reflects the periodic evaluation mechanism aligned with global oil market dynamics, fiscal considerations, and public purchasing power. This reduction could benefit consumers and businesses reliant on these fuel types, and may provide mild relief to inflationary pressures in Indonesia.

medium.title: Trump Orders Gas Stations to Immediately Lower Fuel Prices
medium.summary: US President Donald Trump issued a strong ultimatum to fuel retailers to immediately lower gasoline prices, warning of serious consequences for non-compliance and calling excessive price hikes illegal. Trump noted that global oil prices have already fallen significantly from levels seen during the US-Iran conflict. This development is relevant to Indonesian investors as sustained lower global oil prices could further support Pertamina's fuel price reductions and ease Indonesia's energy import costs.

medium.title: Avjet Fuel Prices Are Falling — So Why Are Airline Tickets Still Expensive?
medium.summary: Despite a decline in jet fuel (avtur) prices in the United States following the Iran conflict, airline ticket prices have not followed suit, with carriers like Delta citing earlier cost burdens as justification for maintaining high fares. This trend is relevant to Indonesia's aviation sector, as similar dynamics could play out domestically given that avtur prices are also declining locally. Indonesian consumers and aviation-related investors should monitor whether local airlines pass on fuel cost savings to passengers.

medium.title: Indonesia-Belarus Trade Target Set at USD 500 Million, 17 MoUs Signed Covering Heavy Equipment and Fertilizer Industries
medium.summary: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto has set a trade target of USD 500 million with Belarus, more than doubling the current trade value of USD 220 million following the signing of the Indonesia-EAEU agreement. The two countries witnessed the signing of 17 business-to-business MoUs, with a focus on cooperation in heavy equipment and fertilizer industries. The visit is in preparation for Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko's trip to Indonesia on July 1, signaling an expanding economic partnership with Eastern Europe.

medium.title: Indonesia to Boost Cocoa and CPO Exports to Belarus
medium.summary: Indonesia's Agriculture Minister Andi Amran Sulaiman met with Belarus's Agriculture Minister to discuss expanding exports of cocoa (approximately 120,000 tons per year), Crude Palm Oil (CPO), coconut, and tea. Belarus is being positioned as a strategic gateway for Indonesian agricultural products into the Eastern European market. The two countries also agreed to strengthen cooperation in agricultural technology, irrigation modernization, and agricultural sector investment.

medium.title: Hutama Karya Introduces 'Mozy' App Featuring Touchless Toll Payment
medium.summary: State-owned toll road operator PT Hutama Karya (Persero) is rolling out new features for its Mozy toll road management app, including MozyTru, a touchless toll payment system currently in pilot testing. The app also introduces MoNgeGame, an educational gaming feature, and Reminder Notification for real-time trip planning and traffic updates. This development signals Hutama Karya's push toward digital transformation of toll road services, which could improve operational efficiency and user experience on its Trans-Sumatra highway network.

medium.title: Ministry of Energy Prepares 3kg CNG as Alternative to 3kg LPG Subsidized Gas
medium.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) is developing 3kg Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) cylinders as a substitute for the heavily subsidized 3kg LPG, aiming to reduce costly import dependency — currently Indonesia produces only 1.8–1.9 million tons of LPG annually against consumption of 8.5 million tons. The CNG price will be set equal to the existing 3kg LPG price to avoid burdening consumers. This policy shift has significant implications for energy subsidy costs, domestic gas producers, and the broader energy sector.

medium.title: Trump Orders Gas Stations to Immediately Lower Fuel Prices
medium.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump issued a stark warning to fuel retailers to immediately lower gasoline prices, stating that excessive price increases are illegal given that global oil prices have fallen significantly since the U.S.-Iran conflict. This development reflects ongoing global oil price dynamics that directly influence Indonesia's fuel pricing and Pertamina's cost structure. Indonesian investors should watch global crude trends as they feed into domestic non-subsidized fuel price adjustments.

medium.title: Indonesia Looks to Hong Kong Stock Exchange as Model for IDX Demutualization
medium.summary: OJK's Capital Markets Chief Hasan Fawzi revealed that Indonesia is benchmarking the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEx), as well as Japan and South Korea's exchanges, as reference models for the planned demutualization of the IDX. OJK leadership has already met with HKEx's CEO and management team to discuss their experience with demutualization. This signals a structured and internationally-informed approach to transforming Indonesia's stock exchange into a publicly-listed entity.

medium.title: IDX Warns Investors: Don't Be FOMO and Blindly Follow Influencers
medium.summary: IDX Development Director Jeffry Hendrik cautioned Indonesia's growing base of over 28 million capital market investors against making investment decisions based on Fear of Missing Out (FOMO) or blindly following social media influencers. He stressed the need for investors to improve their financial literacy, understand individual stock risk profiles, and conduct proper analysis before investing. The warning reflects concerns about investor quality amid rapid growth in retail participation in Indonesian capital markets.
